task_completion.description: Create a local BLAST database from the E. coli genome file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: UGENE 'Build BLAST Database' dialog or a log message indicating the successful creation of a database from 'ecoli_genome.fasta'.

task_completion.description: Configure BLASTN search with the 16S query and E-value threshold.
task_completion.visual_evidence: BLAST search dialog showing '16s_query.fasta' as the input and the E-value threshold set to 1e-10 or lower.

task_completion.description: Run BLAST and identify hits as annotations on the genome sequence.
task_completion.visual_evidence: UGENE sequence view showing multiple annotations (hits) labeled on the E. coli genome sequence after the BLAST run.

task_completion.description: Export the annotated genome as a GenBank file to the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Export dialog or file explorer showing 'ecoli_16s_annotated.gb' being saved to '~/UGENE_Data/blast/results/'.

task_completion.description: Create a plain text summary report with the count and coordinates.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or file preview showing '16s_blast_report.txt' containing the number 7 and a list of start/end coordinates.

integrity.description: The agent used the UGENE GUI to perform the bioinformatics tasks.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show interactions with UGENE menus, dialogs, and sequence views rather than just terminal commands.

integrity.description: The BLAST results were generated by the software, not manually typed.
integrity.visual_evidence: The UGENE 'Task Manager' or progress bars showing the BLAST process running, and the resulting annotations appearing automatically in the sequence view.

integrity.description: The agent used the specific file paths provided in the instructions.
integrity.visual_evidence: File paths in the 'Save' or 'Open' dialogs match '~/UGENE_Data/blast/...' as specified.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The E. coli genome size is 4,641,652 bp. A correct BLASTN search with the provided 16S query and E-value (1e-10) must identify exactly 7 hits/copies. The final report must reflect this count (7) and provide their coordinates. The output files must be named 'ecoli_16s_annotated.gb' and '16s_blast_report.txt' in the 'results' subdirectory.
